subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Digital Wills and Estate Planning
description: A fast breakdown of Digital Wills and Estate Planning for builders.

hook.text: You plan who gets your house and car. But who gets your email, photos, and cryptocurrency?

buildup.text: Digital estate planning involves designating someone to manage your online accounts after death.

discovery.text: Apple, Google, and Facebook now offer legacy contact features — letting you name someone to access your account.

twist.text: Most people never set up digital legacy contacts. Their accounts become permanently inaccessible vaults.

climax.text: Your digital life holds memories, money, and meaning. Without a plan, it all becomes locked and lost.

punchline.text: Plan your digital legacy. Before it's too late.

quiz.question: What is a legacy contact on platforms like Apple and Google?
options: A designated person who can access your account after death
A backup email address for password recovery
A lawyer who manages your online presence
